method: Hand-adjudicated. Candidate boundaries were pooled from TransNetV2 (t=0.5) and PySceneDetect ContentDetector at thresholds 27, 15 and 10, giving 42 distinct candidates. Every candidate not agreed by both detectors was inspected as a frame-pair (b-2, b+2) in results/eval/{disputed,recall_a,recall_b}.jpg and judged cut / not-cut by eye.

rejected_candidates.note: Inspected and judged NOT cuts - all are camera/subject motion inside a continuous take.

notes: f3282 (exterior bus -> interior bus) is a real cut found only by TransNetV2; PySceneDetect at t=27 missed it.
f3045, f3126, f3151 are PySceneDetect false positives from fast bus/pan motion.
Shots 8 (58.5-82.1s) and 9 (82.1-112.6s) are genuinely long single takes - both detectors agree, and the dense-crowd candidates inside them were all rejected on inspection.
